html:
Apple is an American technology company, founded in 1976 by Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak in a garage in California. It made the personal computer, and later the smartphone, into products for everyone.

Its Apple II of 1977 was one of the first home computers sold in large numbers. The Macintosh of 1984 brought the mouse and on screen windows to the mass market. By the mid 1990s, though, Apple was losing money and close to failing.

Jobs returned in 1997 and turned it around:

  • 2001: the iPod music player, then the iTunes store
  • 2007: the iPhone, and a year later the App Store
  • 2010: the iPad

Under Tim Cook, chief executive from 2011, it became the first US company valued at a trillion dollars, in 2018. Its devices are designed in Cupertino in Silicon Valley but mostly assembled in China by contractors such as Foxconn. That makes Apple a symbol of the globalised supply chains of the early 21st century.
sum: Apple is an American technology company, founded in 1976 by Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak in a garage in California. It made the personal computer, and later the smartphone, into products for everyone.
